results.method: bash scripts/check.sh; python3 integration/torchlean/check.py; python3 -m unittest discover -s hardware -p test_*.py; /home/lothar/.pyenv/versions/fresh/bin/python hardware/validate_dense.py --output .hardware-runs/dense-forward-final --ptx-version 9.2 --sanitizers; extracted receipt archive GPU replay; source and archive SHA-256 verification; distribution scan; Stratic validation; manual restricted PTX 9.2/9.4 compatibility and entry adapter review
results.environment: RTX 5090 sm_120; driver 610.57.04; CUDA ptxas 13.2.78; Python 3.12; PyTorch 2.11.0+cu130; repository-pinned Lean dependencies. Formal semantics PTX 9.4; explicit emitted PTX 9.2 compatibility subset.
results.evidence: Root checks passed with 1643 exact axiom reports; integration checks passed with 2462 exact axiom reports and only standard Lean axioms. Eight CPU tests passed. Final scoped-relaxed PTX artifacts passed 37 cases/341 coordinates with three repeats: bit equality to Lean and independent rational rounding; exact theorem-derived error allowances satisfied. PyTorch has 67 differing coordinates including cancellation result 2 versus kernel 1; its separately stated unproved diagnostic allowance passed. memcheck, racecheck, synccheck and initcheck reported zero errors/hazards. Published archive extracted and all 37 cases replayed successfully. Source hashes and archive hash match. Distribution scan found no vendor manual or raw transcripts. Before/after final snapshots match. This is empirical evidence, not a verified emitter/runtime/hardware or cross-version refinement theorem.
